column1: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the salt, and cook the pasta until al dente.
Meanwhile, whisk the 105g water and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Heat over medium, stirring constantly, until it thickens.
Put the grated Pecorino and olive oil in a blender. Add the thickened cornstarch and blend into a smooth cheese slurry.
Toast the peppercorns in a large pan until fragrant, then grind them.
Return the ground pepper to the pan, add the 1/4 cup of water, then stir in the cheese slurry to make a sauce.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce, toss to coat, and serve.
